shaSeparation.note: Per SKYLINE 2026-06-28 R3.0 Final Continuous Execution Directive §7, every checkpoint manifest preserves the three-way SHA separation. reviewedCandidateSha is the exact SHA Codex D1 review was issued against; manifestCommitSha is this manifest's own commit; integrationSha is the post-merge Train HEAD. Substituting one for another is a tier violation.
shaSeparation.reviewedCandidateNote: Filled by a follow-up evidence-anchoring commit after Codex D1 issues PASS against the exact candidate SHA on feat/r3.0d-d1-evidence-decision-contracts.
shaSeparation.manifestCommitNote: Filled by the same follow-up evidence-anchoring commit; mirrors C5R / C6 / C7 / C8 convention.
shaSeparation.integrationNote: Filled only after the D1 branch-to-branch PR merges into feat/r3.0-integrated-delivery AND the Train target-context trusted-verification PASSes at that integration HEAD.

contractEnforcements.closedKeySet: Every contract module rejects any extra own key (UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY).
contractEnforcements.plainObjectOnly: Object.getPrototypeOf must be Object.prototype or null; Proxy / class instance fails closed.
contractEnforcements.noProxyEscape: Every validator wraps the descriptor reads in an outer try/catch; hostile getter / accessor throws collapse to a structured INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION or specific *_INVALID code.
contractEnforcements.noSymbolKeys: Object.keys + closed-allowlist enumeration ignore Symbol-keyed properties; non-enumerable extras are caught by descriptor checks.
contractEnforcements.noCycles: evidence-node-contract self-reference check at D1; D2 graph builder will add deep-cycle detection.
contractEnforcements.arrayCaps: Per-field array cap (EDGES_ARRAY_CAP=64; LIMITATIONS_ARRAY_CAP=32; ID_ARRAY_CAP=64; ALTERNATIVE_ARRAY_CAP=16).
contractEnforcements.graphCaps: Decision input: NODES_CAP=256; HYPOTHESES_CAP=64; ALTERNATIVES_CAP=128; VALIDATION_ACTIONS_CAP=128; RECOMMENDATIONS_CAP=32.
contractEnforcements.envelopeCap: Decision input total ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP=256 KiB; Engineer Brief ENVELOPE_BYTE_CAP=64 KiB.
contractEnforcements.prototypePollutionReject: Plain-prototype check excludes objects whose prototype was manipulated.
contractEnforcements.causalOverclaimReject: Hypothesis / Recommendation / Engineer Brief i18nKey + string params are lexically scanned for ['exact_cause', 'driver_fault', 'setup_caused', 'guaranteed_fix', 'professional_diagnosis', 'fastest_setup', 'theoretical_best']; any match → HYPOTHESIS_CAUSAL_OVERCLAIM. D1 enforces the lexical surface; D3 / Codex enforce the semantic.
contractEnforcements.confidenceForbidden: Caller-supplied confidence at D1 MUST be { state: 'unresolved' | 'not_computed' } with no other own key. Any numeric `value` / `score` / `probability` → HYPOTHESIS_CONFIDENCE_FORBIDDEN. Numeric confidence is produced ONLY by D3 PRIORITY_ENGINE.
contractEnforcements.autoTuningForbidden: Recommendation applyMode MUST be 'driver_action' or 'user_initiated'. Any auto_* value → matching RECOMMENDATION_AUTO_*_FORBIDDEN.
contractEnforcements.syntheticHonesty: provenance='synthetic' MUST declare LIMITATION_SYNTHETIC_ONLY in node.limitations.
contractEnforcements.heuristicHonesty: EVIDENCE credibility='heuristic' OR CONCLUSION credibility='Heuristic' MUST declare LIMITATION_HEURISTIC_ONLY in node/hypothesis.limitations.
contractEnforcements.briefMandatoryPresence: Engineer Brief MUST carry the keys { contradictions, alternativeExplanations, cannotConcludeReasonCodes, limitations } even if empty arrays; omission triggers BRIEF_CONTRADICTION_HIDDEN / BRIEF_CANNOT_CONCLUDE_HIDDEN / BRIEF_LIMITATION_HIDDEN. Hidden contradictions is a contract-level violation, not a UI preference.

tests.evidenceTier: TIER 3 — Claude-verified on D1 branch HEAD; CI re-run on integrationSha is the authority for the Train target context.

codexVerdict.tierDisclosure: Codex D1 (the first R3.0D phase gate) will be invoked against the D1 branch candidate SHA. Tier 1 raw stdout MUST be captured and persisted under governance/r3.0d/codex-checkpoint-evidence/D1/round-N-<sha>.md for every round (BLOCK and PASS).

featureRegistryState.note: D1 is a contracts-only checkpoint. No R3.0D feature IDs are introduced into renderer/js/feature-registry.js. The D5 ACTIVATION checkpoint is the only authorised point to add R3.0D feature IDs (decision_engine / hypothesis / engineer_brief — names finalised at D5). Until then the feature registry remains R3.0A/B/C-only.

crossPhaseGate.note: R3.0D D1 is a non-bootstrap checkpoint. Per governance/r3.0/train.schema.json crossPhaseAdvanceRequires.R3.0D = 'R3.0C:C8_ACTIVATION', the precondition is that governance/r3.0c/state.json.currentCheckpoint === 'C8_ACTIVATION'. This is satisfied: R3.0C completed via PR #20 merge on 2026-06-28; Train HEAD = f731887 (the D1 baseSha). See [[project-r3-0c]] for the R3.0C completion record.

note: D1_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION — the first non-bootstrap R3.0D checkpoint. Lifts ONE governance/contract capability (contract_foundation_present); enables NO production capability. NO authorizedProductionPath is added. NO renderer/js file requires contracts/r3.0d. NO index.html script src loads contracts/r3.0d. The eight contract modules under contracts/r3.0d/ define the closed-schema universe (EvidenceNode + Observation + Hypothesis + Contradiction + AlternativeExplanation + ValidationAction + Recommendation + Priority + Engineer Brief + SourceIdentity + Credibility + Confidence + Availability) that D2 EVIDENCE_GRAPH, D3 PRIORITY_ENGINE, D4 ENGINEER_BRIEF will produce/consume. D1 enforces: closed key sets, plain objects only, no Proxy escape, no numeric confidence at the caller layer, no auto_tuning, no causal-overclaim lexical wording, synthetic+heuristic limitation honesty, bounded string/array/envelope caps, fail-closed default. C-B Codex review runs against the exact D1 candidate SHA; tier-1 raw stdout to be persisted under governance/r3.0d/codex-checkpoint-evidence/D1/.
